problem: Is Orthogonal Frontier v2 a transition-sufficient institutional state, or only an Agent-facing currentness summary? If it is insufficient, what latent owner-state residual is future-relevant?
formalCriterion: For an abstraction F to be transition-congruent over the admitted event language, F(h1)=F(h2) should imply F(h1·f)=F(h2·f) for every common admissible future suffix f, relative to the institutional observables under test.
importantBoundary: The experiment does NOT assume every owner-internal transition field belongs on the Agent-facing Frontier. A Frontier counterexample may establish the need for an owner-side continuation kernel or query boundary rather than a larger prompt surface.

abstractions.CONTINUATION_KERNEL_V0: A deterministic owner-side transition kernel containing current office/controller/norm/lineage, exact compromised-root set, current-support claimant set, current remedy, and sanction transition registry needed by the current event semantics; it excludes event log and generic valid/invalid witness lists.

targetedCounterexampleFamilies: hidden exact compromised-root identity under the same DEGRADED frontier
hidden single current-support authority claimant under an uncontested frontier
hidden sanction identity/status registry under otherwise identical current frontier

registeredInterpretation.FRONTIER_IS_TRANSITION_SUFFICIENT_CANDID: No targeted or random future-divergence counterexample is found for ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER_V2_CORE.
registeredInterpretation.FRONTIER_IS_CURRENT_SUMMARY_NOT_STATE: At least one valid pair with equal Frontier core diverges under a common future suffix.
registeredInterpretation.CONTINUATION_KERNEL_SURVIVES_GENERATIVE_: No divergence is found among equal CONTINUATION_KERNEL_V0 pairs under the frozen random search budget.
registeredInterpretation.LATENT_OWNER_STATE_NEEDED: A minimal counterexample is attributable to a field intentionally omitted from the Agent-facing Frontier but retained in CONTINUATION_KERNEL_V0.

guards: A divergence must be measured on institutional observables, not merely occurrenceDigest/eventCount.
Targeted pair members must have identical Frontier core before the suffix and distinct histories.
For the sanction-registry targeted pair, brute resource state must also be equal before the common suffix so the counterexample is not a World-state alias.
Random kernel equivalence is a bounded falsification result, not a proof of minimality or completeness.
A Frontier failure does not automatically justify exposing owner-transition internals to Agents.
No S1-S4 model evidence is retroactively rescored.
